name: Palwal

routes.outcome: First-party District Palwal, Haryana Web-HALRIS, and Government of India DILRMP sources were discovered; no safe parcel feature response was present.
First-party Hindi District Palwal land-record service was found; no safe parcel feature response was present.
Official District Palwal page identifies Revenue Department Haryana land records, registration, mutation and Jamabandi, links to jamabandi.nic.in, and locates the Palwal tehsil office.
Official Hindi District Palwal portal identifies राजस्व(भू-अभिलेख) service.
Official Haryana DITECH page describes Web-HALRIS modules for deed registration, Jamabandi, mutation, Khasra Girdawari and reports; implementation in 143 tehsils.

Search-indexed official DILRMP dashboard reports Palwal tehsil: 1,094 cadastral maps/FMBs/Tippans, 148 villages, 1,094 digitized maps. Direct local curl failed certificate-chain verification; TLS verification was not disabled.
Bounded anonymous request timed out after 15 seconds with no response body; not treated as service or parcel absence.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfiguration: No current public parcel viewer JavaScript/configuration or anonymous ID-plus-geometry endpoint was successfully retrieved. Official pages establish Web-HALRIS/Jamabandi as the land-record system but do not expose a safe parcel schema in observed responses.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified

qualification.reason: No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified; no sample GeoJSON was retained.

scopeLimits: Official DILRMP counts are district/tehsil inventory evidence, not a verified Palwal municipal boundary.
Palwal city, Palwal tehsil, and surrounding revenue villages may have different boundaries.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to force a parcel hit.
A timeout or TLS-chain failure does not prove service or parcel absence.
No parcel polygon was retained because no safe native identity-plus-geometry response was obtained.
uncertainty: This packet documents a real Haryana/District Palwal registry custodian and official cadastral-map inventory evidence, but not source integration or admission. Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial qualification of a safe public parcel response.
